correctness.rationale: Uniform polar boundary expansion and compact near-antipodal localization give exact two-point exceedance intensity 16/(15 pi^2) times the angular integral. Overlapping-pair factorial moment terms vanish at n^{(2-v)/5} for connected v>=3, proving the Poisson limit for each fixed t. Lens diameter differs from 2 only by O(n^-8/5). Disk endpoint and small/large t powers checked; seeded numerical simulation separately corroborates normalization without substituting for proof.

value.rationale: The perturbation lambda n^-4/5 is matched to the canonical random-disk diameter deficit and produces a complete one-parameter non-Weibull crossover law, not a routine constant computation. Angular support changes at t=2lambda, and exact leading exponents 7/2 versus 5/2 quantify a natural transition from disk isotropy to localized diametral directions.
